key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0A50
name: conditionally_save_register_context
description: Tests a global flag and, when it is set, calls two unnamed routines and copies the data and address register values into fixed memory slots. It then writes a stored word back and returns.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0A80
name: advance_four_voice_sequences
description: Steps through four voice records once per tick, decoding each record's command nibble to set volume, period and sequence pointers. It calls unnamed routines and also touches the custom hardware block.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:1116
name: run_voice_effect_commands
description: Walks the voice records backwards and applies one effect command to each active record, such as period slides clamped to fixed limits, volume slides clamped to the range zero to 64, or table-driven offsets. It writes the resulting period and volume into the matching output block.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:1126
name: apply_period_slide_and_resume
description: Applies a downward period slide with a lower clamp to the current voice record, then jumps into the shared voice effect loop to process the remaining records.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:1142
name: fall_through_into_effect_loop
description: A two-instruction fragment that copies the voice's period into its output block and then falls into the shared voice effect loop.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:1172
name: advance_voice_sequence_pointers
description: Walks four voice records and returns early while a record's delay counter is non-zero, decrementing it. Once a counter runs out, it reads the next sequence word, either directly or through an indirect table, and stores the result in the record.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:117E
name: fetch_next_sequence_words
description: Loops over the four voice records and reads the next sequence word for each, using an indirect table when the word is negative. It marks the record active and writes the resolved values into its output fields.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:11A4
name: mark_records_and_resolve_offsets
description: Runs a loop over the voice records that marks each one active, masks its command field and, when an offset is present, stores the resolved address and its contents.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:11AA
name: fetch_voice_word_then_loop
description: Loads a direct or indirect sequence word for the current voice, stores it, and then enters the shared record loop that marks records active and resolves offsets.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:11C0
name: fetch_indirect_sequence_word
description: Loads the next word for a voice from its sequence pointer, using an indirect table entry when the word is negative, then runs the shared record loop that marks records active.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:11D0
name: stream_voice_sequence_words
description: Streams the next sequence word into each voice record, reading a fresh word from the sequence pointer whenever a voice's hold counter has run out. The resolved offset is stored with each record.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:121A
name: run_voice_tick_with_delay
description: Returns early while a delay counter is non-zero, decrementing it. Otherwise it calls one unnamed routine when a pending field is set and then runs the four-voice tick that decodes each record's command nibble.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:1228
name: run_voice_tick_pending_call
description: Clears a flag byte and calls the single-voice effect routine when a pending field is non-zero, then runs the four-voice tick that decodes each record's command nibble and updates volume, period and sequence pointers.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:12B6
name: process_active_voice_records
description: Loops over the four voice records, skipping any whose active flag is clear. For the rest it decodes the command nibble to set volume, period or sequence pointers, and it stores the combined active-flag mask back before returning.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:12FC
name: call_handlers_for_pending_slots

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:1356
name: sync_voice_pointers_when_enabled
description: When an enable flag is set and a counter is set, clears the flag, waits until a status byte changes, and writes two words. It then copies table values into each of the four slots that hold the sentinel value minus one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:139C
name: stub_immediate_return

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:139E
name: process_voice_records_from_entry
description: Loops over the voice records and skips inactive ones, decoding each active record's command nibble to set volume, period or sequence pointers. A second entry point writes a stored period into the record before continuing the loop.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:13C6
name: init_voice_offsets_from_sequence
description: Sets a counter field to 63 and reads four words from a sequence pointer, storing four address offsets into fixed fields of the voice record. It then copies table data for each of four slots that hold the sentinel value minus one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:1C34
name: copy_voice_state_audio_regs
description: Counts down a counter and, when it reaches zero, calls two unnamed routines and resets it. It then keeps the lowest of several six-bit level values and copies four groups of voice words into the audio channel 0 register block whenever the matching enable byte is the sentinel value minus one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:1C68
name: clamp_levels_copy_voice_groups
description: Masks a value to six bits and lowers four stored level fields in the source record to it where they are larger. It then copies four groups of record words into the destination block for each enable byte that holds the sentinel value minus one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:2:0000

name: initialise_hardware_at_entry

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PARADOX:0:032A

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PARADOX:0:03A6

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PARADOX:0:0422

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PARADOX:0:104C

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PARADOX:0:11AA

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PARADOX:0:1208

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PARADOX:0:1290
name: clear_interrupt_and_audio_dma

name: increment_status_byte
